label: POC Onboarding: Import OS Build
mcp_tool_description: Import one image into an OS build and attach the build to the handler's environments, as the handler's images page does. Leave onb_image empty to list the cached images for the location (AMI ids and names; Azure template names and publisher:offer:sku:version; vCenter template names); a partial name narrows the list and imports when exactly one matches. The caches are filled by onb_sync_images; an AMI id that is not cached is fetched on the spot, and an empty Azure or vCenter cache is refreshed without the whitelist first. An existing OS build with onb_os_build_name is reused, so call it once per handler with the same name and one blueprint deploys to both clouds; when CloudBolt attaches the image to a build of another name the response says so. onb_environments limits the attachment (default: every environment of the handler); onb_region names the region or location when it cannot be read from the environments. Runs as a job: poll the returned id with fetch_job. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller. CloudBolt allows one image per OS build per handler (per region on AWS, per location on Azure): when the build already holds another image of the handler, nothing changes and the answer has confirmationRequired with existingImages; ask the user, then call again with onb_replace_existing=true to remove the old image and add the new one.
